hero.title: I build the infrastructure and the automation that get software into production.
hero.lede: I'm {{ownerName}}, a software engineer in Mexico City. I've been in software since 2017, with more than 5 years of experience both as a fullstack developer and as a DevOps/SRE engineer. In recent years I've focused on automating deployments and building the tooling that lets a team ship faster.
